document.title: Help Right Now prototype — Sioux Falls Mutual Aid
quick_exit.label: Quick exit
quick_exit.note: Leaves this page right away, and so does pressing Escape twice on a keyboard. It cannot erase your history, so if someone checks this device, use one they cannot reach.
safety.lead: Someone may be monitoring your phone or device.
safety.body: If that is possible, consider using a safer device before opening outside websites or changing settings.
page.heading: Help right now
page.lede: You do not need to know which organization handles what. Pick where you are, then use the option that fits what is happening right now.
emergency.message: If you are in immediate danger or need emergency medical help, call 911.
location.heading: Where are you?
sf_shelter.name: Children’s Home Shelter for Family Safety
sf_shelter.summary: Emergency shelter and crisis support for people experiencing domestic violence, stalking, sexual assault and other abuse. The shelter says its crisis line is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
sf_shelter.address: 113 N. St. Paul Ave., Sioux Falls
sf_shelter.meta: Last checked Oct. 9, 2026 · Source: Children’s Home Society of South Dakota
clay.heading: Clay County
clay.note: We have less locally verified crisis information for Clay County right now. We will say that instead of pretending a Sioux Falls service is local.
dvsos.name: Domestic Violence Safe Option Services (DVSOS)
dvsos.summary: South Dakota’s current victim-services listing identifies DVSOS in Vermillion as the local domestic-violence service contact.
dvsos.meta: Last checked Oct. 9, 2026 · Source: South Dakota Department of Public Safety
statewide.heading: Statewide / anywhere in South Dakota
lifeline.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
lifeline.summary: Call or text 988 for mental-health or suicide crisis support. The 988 Lifeline says call, text and chat services are available 24/7.
lifeline.meta: Last checked Oct. 9, 2026 · Source: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
prototype.label: Prototype:
prototype.note: This is staging/reference code, not the finished WordPress page. Core phone numbers and crisis information are present in the HTML and remain usable without JavaScript. Quick Exit reuses the existing shared component rather than creating another copy.
